description: A comprehensive, industry-aligned TallyPrime professional course designed from the official TallyPrime Manual & Tally Certification Standards (Tally Essential Levels 1, 2, 3 & Tally Professional). Covers fundamental bookkeeping, double-entry principles, company setup, voucher management, multi-godown inventory, order processing, full GST compliance (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, E-Way Bill, E-Invoicing), TDS/TCS statutory processing, corporate payroll (PF/ESI/PT), MIS reporting, financial analysis, internal audit controls, and real-world commercial case studies.
subject: Tally

segments.title: Segment 1 – Recording & Reporting (Tally Essential Level 1 - Foundation & Core Accounting)
segments.summary: Master bookkeeping principles, double-entry rules, TallyPrime interface, company configuration, chart of accounts (groups & ledgers), voucher recording, and banking reconciliation.

Introduction to Final Accounts: Trading Account, Profit & Loss Account & Balance Sheet
Accounting Fundamentals Practical Assessment & Diagnostic Quiz
learningOutcomes: Understand the core foundations and terminology of commercial bookkeeping
Accurately classify transactions into Personal, Real, and Nominal accounts
Formulate journal entries applying Golden Rules of Accounting
Post transactions to ledgers, balance accounts, and compile an accurate Trial Balance
miniProjects: Analyze and journalize 35 real-world commercial business transactions for a trading firm in Barrackpore
